description:
Analysis source code and group-level imaging and behavioral summaries for an interleaved dual-structure serial reaction time fMRI study.

Version 1.2.0 adds sensitivity analyses requested in review: nuisance-model decomposition, spike-regressor censoring, immediate-repetition sensitivity, joint stage correction, condition-mean component balance, participant-level reaction-time intervals, design statistics and motion by condition. These findings remain exploratory. The 22-participant uncensored reference analysis with at least 80% observed regional support remains primary. The overlapping learner-selected 20-participant sample is a sensitivity reported only in the article supplement. Confidence intervals are pointwise. The analysis history and model selection are disclosed in the article Methods.

Participant-level observations, fitted models, MRI images, raw permutation arrays and recoverable individual values are withheld. The complete original run_saved.py is withheld; only its generic direct comparison function and necessary imports are distributed. Code labels and paths refer to restricted inputs. Approved data access and separate dependencies are required to re-estimate models.

Version 1.2.0 applies stricter suppression to overlapping sample and coverage summaries and supersedes version 1.1.0 for citation. Derived ROI displays that could restore suppressed values are withheld.

Original software is MIT; group summaries, figures and documentation are CC BY 4.0. Version 1.1.0 remains available at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23471923 and version 1.0.0 at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23438462.
